scenario: A 150-square-foot habitable den has only 6 square feet of window glazing (4% of floor area). The den is equipped with a permanently installed lighting system that produces an average illumination of 8 footcandles measured 30 inches above the floor across the entire room.
policy: General rule: Every habitable room must have an aggregate glazing (window) area of not less than 8% of the room's floor area to provide natural light. Override: Natural light is not required, and the 8% glazing rule does not apply, where artificial light is provided capable of producing an average illumination of 6 footcandles over the area of the room at a height of 30 inches above the floor.
question: Does the den comply with the natural-light requirement?
